patterns.name: SQL Injection via raw POST
patterns.description: Raw $_POST values interpolated into SQL query strings

patterns.name: OTP bypass via loose comparison
patterns.description: OTP/password checks using == instead of === allow type juggling bypass

patterns.name: No auth check on destructive operation
patterns.description: Functions like clear_database, db_backup without role/auth check

patterns.name: trans_commit on failure branch
patterns.description: trans_commit() called after error check — should be trans_rollback()
patterns.context_check: Check if called inside error/failure branch

patterns.name: trans_complete instead of begin/commit
patterns.description: CI2 trans_complete() auto-commits regardless of errors — should use trans_begin/commit/rollback

patterns.name: Direct $_POST usage
patterns.description: $_POST used instead of $this->input->post() — no XSS filtering

patterns.name: Date-suffixed method copy
patterns.description: Legacy method copy with date suffix (e.g., getBillDetails_30_08_2025) — old version may be called

patterns.name: Commented-out function body
patterns.description: Large blocks of commented code inside functions (debug residue)

patterns.name: rate.txt Array bug
patterns.description: file_put_contents writes 'Array' string instead of json_encode — breaks mobile API

patterns.name: Journal not reversed on cancel
patterns.description: cancel_bill() does not reverse ret_journal entries — financial data orphaned
patterns.context_check: Verify ret_journal reversal exists in cancel function

patterns.name: Purchase cancel stock inversion
patterns.description: cancel_bill() adds NT stock back (correct for sales) but wrong for purchase cancel (should subtract)
patterns.context_check: Check if bill_type=4 uses same stock logic as type=1

patterns.name: Variable used outside foreach loop
patterns.description: Loop variable used after foreach ends — only references last iteration
patterns.context_check: Check if variable from foreach is used after closing brace
